vsm1.7:89.7: esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo, pāhuneyyo, dakkhiṇeyyo, añjalikaraṇīyo,
vsm1.7:89.8: anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā’’ti (a. ni. 6.10) evaṃ ariyasaṅghaguṇā anussaritabbā.
vsm1.7:90.2: sammāpaṭipadaṃ anivattipaṭipadaṃ anulomapaṭipadaṃ apaccanīkapaṭipadaṃ dhammānudhammapaṭipadaṃ paṭipannoti vuttaṃ hoti.
vsm1.7:90.6: Yasmā pana sā sammāpaṭipadā uju avaṅkā akuṭilā ajimhā,
vsm1.7:90.7: ariyo ca ñāyotipi vuccati, anucchavikattā ca sāmīcītipi saṅkhaṃ gatā.
vsm1.7:91.1: Ettha ca ye maggaṭṭhā, te sammāpaṭipattisamaṅgitāya suppaṭipannā.
vsm1.7:91.2: Ye phalaṭṭhā, te sammāpaṭipadāya adhigantabbassa adhigatattā atītaṃ paṭipadaṃ sandhāya suppaṭipannāti veditabbā.
vsm1.7:92.4: kāyavacīmanovaṅkakuṭilajimhadosappahānāya paṭipannattā ca ujuppaṭipannattā ca ujuppaṭipanno.
vsm1.7:92.5: Ñāyo vuccati nibbānaṃ. Tadatthāya paṭipannattā ñāyappaṭipanno.
vsm1.7:92.6: Yathā paṭipannā sāmīcippaṭipannārahā honti, tathā paṭipannattā sāmīcippaṭipanno.
vsm1.7:93.8: Ettha ca purisoti vā puggaloti vā ekatthāni etāni padāni.
vsm1.7:93.12: pāṭiekkato aṭṭha purisapuggalā, esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho,
vsm1.7:94.5: Taṃ āhunaṃ paṭiggahetuṃ yutto tassa mahapphalakaraṇatoti āhuneyyo.
vsm1.7:95.1: Atha vā dūratopi āgantvā sabbasāpateyyampi ettha hunitabbanti āhavanīyo.
vsm1.7:95.3: Yo cāyaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ āhavanīyo nāma aggi,
vsm1.7:95.5: Sace hutassa mahapphalatāya āhavanīyo, saṅghova āhavanīyo.
vsm1.7:95.8: ‘‘Yo ca vassasataṃ jantu, aggiṃ paricare vane;
vsm1.7:95.10: Sāyeva pūjanā seyyo, yañce vassasataṃ huta’’nti. (dha. pa. 107);
vsm1.7:95.12: idha āhuneyyoti iminā padena atthato ekaṃ.
vsm1.7:96.2: disāvidisato āgatānaṃ piyamanāpānaṃ ñātimittānamatthāya sakkārena paṭiyattaṃ āgantukadānaṃ.
vsm1.7:96.3: Tampi ṭhapetvā te tathārūpe pāhunake saṅghasseva dātuṃ yuttaṃ, saṅghova taṃ paṭiggahetuṃ yutto.
vsm1.7:96.5: Tathā hesa ekabuddhantare ca dissati, abbokiṇṇañca piyamanāpattakarehi dhammehi samannāgatoti.
vsm1.7:96.6: Evaṃ pāhunamassa dātuṃ yuttaṃ pāhunañca paṭiggahetuṃ yuttoti pāhuneyyo.
vsm1.7:96.9: tasmā sabbapaṭhamaṃ ānetvā ettha hunitabbanti pāhavanīyo.
vsm1.7:97.1: Dakkhiṇāti pana paralokaṃ saddahitvā dātabbadānaṃ vuccati.
vsm1.7:97.3: dakkhiṇāya vā hito yasmā naṃ mahapphalakaraṇatāya visodhetīti
vsm1.7:98.1: Ubho hatthe sirasmiṃ patiṭṭhapetvā sabbalokena kayiramānaṃ añjalikammaṃ arahatīti añjalikaraṇīyo.
vsm1.7:98.2: Anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti sabbalokassa asadisaṃ puññavirūhanaṭṭhānaṃ.
vsm1.7:98.3: Yathā hi rañño vā amaccassa vā sālīnaṃ vā yavānaṃ vā virūhanaṭṭhānaṃ
vsm1.7:98.6: Saṅghaṃ nissāya hi lokassa nānappakārahitasukhasaṃvattanikāni puññāni virūhanti.
vsm1.7:99.2: neva tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
vsm1.7:99.3: Na dosa…pe… na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
vsm1.7:99.4: Ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti saṅghaṃ ārabbhāti (a. ni. 6.10)
vsm1.7:99.9: Tadetaṃ saṅghaguṇānussaraṇavasena uppannattā saṅghānussaticceva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
vsm1.7:100.1: Imañca pana saṅghānussatiṃ anuyutto bhikkhu saṅghe sagāravo hoti sappatisso.
vsm1.7:100.11: sammukhā saṅghaṃ passato viya hirottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhāti,
vsm1.7:101.2: ‘‘aho vata me sīlāni akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni
vsm1.7:101.3: bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikānī’’ti (a. ni. 6.10) evaṃ akhaṇḍatādiguṇavasena attano sīlāni anussaritabbāni.
vsm1.7:101.4: Tāni ca gahaṭṭhena gahaṭṭhasīlāni, pabbajitena pabbajitasīlāni.
vsm1.7:102.2: yesaṃ ādimhi vā ante vā ekampi na bhinnaṃ,
vsm1.7:102.3: tāni pariyante chinnasāṭako viya na khaṇḍānīti akhaṇḍāni.
vsm1.7:102.4: Yesaṃ vemajjhe ekampi na bhinnaṃ, tāni majjhe vinividdhasāṭako viya na chiddānīti acchiddāni.
vsm1.7:102.5: Yesaṃ paṭipāṭiyā dve vā tīṇi vā na bhinnāni,
vsm1.7:102.6: tāni piṭṭhiyā vā kucchiyā vā uṭṭhitena dīghavaṭṭādisaṇṭhānena visabhāgavaṇṇena kāḷarattādīnaṃ aññatarasarīravaṇṇā gāvī viya
vsm1.7:102.9: tāni visabhāgabinduvicitrā gāvī viya na kammāsānīti akammāsāni.
vsm1.7:103.1: Avisesena vā sabbānipi sattavidhena methunasaṃyogena kodhupanāhādīhi ca pāpadhammehi anupahatattā akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni.
vsm1.7:104.4: kenaci vā ayaṃ te sīlesu dosoti evaṃ parāmaṭṭhuṃ asakkuṇeyyatāya aparāmaṭṭhāni.
vsm1.7:104.6: atha vā pana maggasamādhiṃ phalasamādhiñcāpi saṃvattentīti samādhisaṃvattanikāni.
vsm1.7:105.2: nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
vsm1.7:105.3: Na dosa…pe… na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
vsm1.7:105.4: Ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, sīlaṃ ārabbhāti
vsm1.7:105.9: Tadetaṃ sīlaguṇānussaraṇavasena uppannattā sīlānussaticceva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
vsm1.7:106.1: Imañca pana sīlānussatiṃ anuyutto bhikkhu sikkhāya sagāravo hoti
vsm1.7:106.9:
Tasmā have appamādaṃ, kayirātha sumedhaso;
Evaṃ mahānubhāvāya, sīlānussatiyā sadāti.
